record_id.name: record_id
record_id.description: one row of the released table

source_key.name: source_key
source_key.description: which custodian the row comes from (four in the CC BY deposit, five in the union)

custodian.name: custodian
custodian.description: the laboratory that produced and published the measurement

cell_id.name: cell_id
cell_id.description: the cell, unique across the collection; the primary entity

cell_id_local.name: cell_id_local
cell_id_local.description: the cell's name in the custodian's own files (U1, Cell10, CCM B, U.C)

stack_id.name: stack_id
stack_id.description: the stack the cell belongs to, where the source names one

checkpoint_index.name: checkpoint_index
checkpoint_index.description: rank of the ordinary ageing checkpoint within the cell, 1 = beginning of test; null on a recovery-event curve (see checkpoint_kind)

checkpoint_kind.name: checkpoint_kind
checkpoint_kind.description: ageing for an ordinary ageing checkpoint; recovery_event for a curve the custodian recorded after a recovery event its file name names (ZSW files ending _afterAirAirStart: a passive air/air start-up, then an extra nominal curve that measures reversible losses); a recovery-event curve is not an ageing checkpoint and is not counted as one

recovery_event_index.name: recovery_event_index
recovery_event_index.description: rank of the recovery-event curve within the cell in time order; null on an ordinary ageing checkpoint

ageing_hours.name: ageing_hours
ageing_hours.description: operating hours at the checkpoint, for hours-based protocols; null for cycle-based

ageing_cycles.name: ageing_cycles
ageing_cycles.description: accelerated-stress or drive cycles at the checkpoint, for cycle-based protocols; null for hours-based

ageing_protocol.name: ageing_protocol
ageing_protocol.description: how the cell was aged, as the custodian describes it

condition_label.name: condition_label
condition_label.description: operating condition of the polarisation measurement, as the custodian labels it

rh_pct.name: rh_pct
rh_pct.description: relative humidity of the reactant stream where the custodian states it; FCLAB (union only): air inlet RH from the ageing series; null otherwise

temperature_C.name: temperature_C
temperature_C.description: cell operating temperature as the custodian records it: ZSW coolant inlet T.Si.CL (set point 70 C), RWTH and Fraunhofer the stated cell temperature, FCLAB cooling-water outlet; null where not recorded

dewpoint_anode_C.name: dewpoint_anode_C
dewpoint_anode_C.description: anode inlet dew point where recorded per row (ZSW); null otherwise

dewpoint_cathode_C.name: dewpoint_cathode_C
dewpoint_cathode_C.description: cathode inlet dew point where recorded per row (ZSW); null otherwise

pressure_anode_kPa.name: pressure_anode_kPa
pressure_anode_kPa.description: anode inlet pressure in the reference pressure_reference names; null where not recorded or where the custodian states a range (Fraunhofer between-cycling checkpoints: '1 - 2' bara)

pressure_cathode_kPa.name: pressure_cathode_kPa
pressure_cathode_kPa.description: cathode inlet pressure in the reference pressure_reference names; null where not recorded

pressure_reference.name: pressure_reference
pressure_reference.description: gauge or absolute, as the custodian's unit states; 'not stated' where the custodian gives bar without saying

stoich_anode.name: stoich_anode
stoich_anode.description: anode stoichiometry where recorded (ZSW per row); null otherwise

stoich_cathode.name: stoich_cathode
stoich_cathode.description: cathode stoichiometry where recorded (ZSW per row, RWTH from the operating parameter sheet); null otherwise

conditions_source.name: conditions_source
conditions_source.description: where the condition values on this row come from, or why they are null

point_index.name: point_index
point_index.description: order of the point within its checkpoint file. Point tables (Fraunhofer, RWTH, PoliMi) visit one current density ascending and descending and both points are kept under distinct point_index; binned rows (FCLAB, ZSW) hold one point per bin, so point_index is 1 for them

current_density_A_cm2.name: current_density_A_cm2
current_density_A_cm2.description: current density; for FCLAB and ZSW the median of a 0.02 A/cm2 bin of the sweep
current_density_A_cm2.provenance: custodian column, binned by build_dpo04_pemfc.py where noted

cell_voltage_V.name: cell_voltage_V
cell_voltage_V.description: cell voltage; RWTH mV converted to V; for sweeps the median within the bin

n_samples_in_bin.name: n_samples_in_bin
n_samples_in_bin.description: samples aggregated into the row: 1 for point tables, more for binned sweeps

dwell_s.name: dwell_s
dwell_s.description: time the sweep spent in the bin: ZSW from the file's clock (samples times the median sampling interval); FCLAB ESTIMATED as the bin's share of the file's samples times the custodian's stated 1000 s sweep (measurement_kind says so; the files hold more samples than one rate over 1000 s, the surplus at open circuit, so the estimate is a share, not a clock); null for point tables

measurement_kind.name: measurement_kind
measurement_kind.description: polarisation_points or binned_from_sweep, with any unit conversion named; for FCLAB it also says that dwell_s is estimated from the custodian's stated 1000 s sweep

controlled_variable.name: controlled_variable
controlled_variable.description: which quantity the custodian's station set at each point: current density (galvanostatic) or cell voltage (potentiostatic; Fraunhofer's released points sit on a voltage grid)
controlled_variable.provenance: custodian protocol and the released grid

source_file.name: source_file
source_file.description: the custodian file (and archive) the row was read from
